intro: Deepmoss Eggs are the clustered clutches laid by deepmoss spiders in the crags and canyons of the Stonetalon Mountains. Coveted by opportunistic goblin merchants in Ratchet, they are destined to become an exotic culinary delicacy in the pirate port of Booty Bay.

p: Deepmoss spiders nest across the craggy heights of the Stonetalon Mountains, particularly throughout Sishir Canyon and beneath the remaining trees of Windshear Crag. The clutches they leave behind contain viable arachnid eggs, sheltered beneath thick webbed sacks and damp mountain moss. While unappealing to most travelers, these egg sacks have caught the eye of goblin commerce.

In the southern port of Booty Bay, spider egg omelettes have surfaced as an eccentric gastronomic craze. Because local supplies cannot meet the appetite of wealthy pirates and adventurous gourmands, Ratchet merchant Mebok Mizzyrix coordinates shipments through Wharfmaster Dizzywig. Adventurers brave the venomous broods of Stonetalon to harvest fresh clutches, turning dangerous spider nests into lucrative shipping contracts.
